feeds.title: Soundsphere magazine
feeds.description: An online and print guide to alternative music (rock, goth, metal, electronic, indie) and culture for the North of England and worldwide. They champion alternative music in the North of England and feature bands, artists and culture on a local, national and international level.

feeds.title: BlackPlastic.co.uk
feeds.description: BlackPlastic.co.uk is an alternative music blog focused on sharing the best electronic music.

feeds.title: Turtle Tempo
feeds.description: A London-based music blog that cares about new music. We are committed to giving talented indie & alternative music artists the recognition they deserve.

feeds.title: Louder Than War Blog
feeds.description: Louder Than War is one of the UK's fastest-growing and award-winning music and culture websites. Louder Than War is a music and counter-culture website and record label that brings you all the latest music latest rock, punk, metal, and alternative music news, album and gig reviews, news and interviews as well as covering counter-culture film, TV, and art.

feeds.title: AnalogueTrash Blog
feeds.description: AnalogueTrash is an independent record label, management and promotions company run by Adrian Brian Thompson and Mark Buckley (hello!), based in Manchester, England. Get Independent music news, reviews, alternative and grassroots music in all its forms on our bog

feeds.title: Neon Filler Blog
feeds.description: Neon Filler was created in 2009 by Joe Lepper and Dorian Rogers. Since then it has grown to include articles by our wonderful bunch of contributors, regular Top 10 features and in 2011 we published our Top 100 Indie and Alternative Albums list. Indie Music UK is the home of indie and alt music website.

feeds.title: NoNewWaveNoFun
feeds.description: Alternative music reviews, news, and interviews. NoNewWaveNoFun believes that if there's no new wave, there's no fun. Here you can get the live preview, news video updates, insight into some artists' new albums, and more!

feeds.title: AltCorner
feeds.description: Featuring Track of the Day, regular features, and announcements from established and upcoming bands throughout the UK and beyond! AltCorner is the promotional platform for alternative music, documenting upcoming artists and established alternative acts.

feeds.title: IndieCentralMusic
feeds.description: Discovering New Music since October 2014. IndieCentralMusic is the home of the latest indie and alternative music. Follow this blog to find the latest indie and alternative music news, reviews, and discoveries, along with radio, TV & gigs!

feeds.title: KLOF Magazine
feeds.description: The UK's leading online Folk Music Magazine covers independent Non-mainstream music including Folk, Acoustic, Americana, Experimental, and Alternative music. Founded in 2004 by Alex Gallacher, KLOF Mag is an eclectic music and culture zine featuring recommendations and reviews, interviews & guest features, and more. Their writers include journalists, former writers for the music press, and those who share their passion for the music they love.

feeds.title: The Alternative Mixtapes
feeds.description: Find your next musicalcrush here and get latest additions to the mixtapes. Stay tuned for the best alternative music updates.

feeds.title: Indie Midlands
feeds.description: Get to know about Indie & Alternative Music in the West Midland and beyond, IndieMidlands is the site dedicated to that! Keeping you up to date with all the latest gigs and music in the West Midlands and more.
